about_the_game:
Adventure Mansion is a multiplayer adventure where a mysterious Host drives players through a shifting mansion of fast, unpredictable challenges and choices.

Sessions unfold as a rapid series of competitive, cooperative, and asymmetrical rounds. Some challenges push the entire group toward a shared goal. Others pit players directly against each other, with changing rules that reward speed, restraint, or calculated risk.

Progress is simple and visible: win rounds to earn coins, trade coins for keys, and use a key for a single chance to unlock the correct chest and win the game.

Failure never removes players from play. Instead, it reshapes the competition, creating sudden reversals and new advantages that keep every round relevant until the end.

No two sessions play the same.
Every choice matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Adventure Mansion is a multiplayer adventure game led by a mysterious Host, where fast challenges, shifting alliances, and high-pressure choices drive every session toward a single decisive end.
